how: We read the website of every Tampa wedding videographer listed on Lazo (110 listings, 86 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: marketing agencies and corporate production houses, a home-movie transfer service that also films funerals, a Tennessee crew that travels in, and a chain with a landing page per city. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you capture vows on a windy beach or in a loud barn: lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
Is there an hourly cap, and what happens if the reception runs late?

picks.name: Hatfield Productions
picks.blurb: Brett Hatfield has filmed more than 700 weddings since 2007, building cinematic documentary films around real vows, speeches and laughter. Tampa-based, covering Clearwater Beach and St. Petersburg, with films from local venues embedded on the site.

picks.name: Labif Filmhouse
picks.blurb: A boutique St. Petersburg film team whose motto is there, but not there, because nobody likes a camera jutting into the moment. Labif makes authentic, cinematic wedding films for Tampa, St. Pete, Sarasota, Naples and destinations.

picks.name: Your Wedding Day Film, LLC
picks.blurb: Founder Vanessa believes wedding films should feel like memories in motion, and has spent years filming across Tampa Bay, Miami and destinations beyond. The Clearwater studio does cinematic films and photography, with an FAQ page that answers the practical questions first.

picks.name: Henry M Production
picks.blurb: Henry came to the U.S. from Vietnam at nine and now photographs and films weddings across Tampa Bay with more than 12 years of experience. He works Vietnamese, Indian and American weddings, from first look to last dance, out of Clearwater.

picks.name: Kingsley James Studios
picks.blurb: Now booking 2026 through 2028 for wedding photography and films, with calm, intentional storytelling for couples who want to remember how the day felt. The Central Florida studio traces its start to a first camera bought in college in 2016.

picks.name: Haven Photo and Films
picks.blurb: Maryel and Alfredo Gonzalez are a husband-and-wife duo who met at a Winter Haven networking event in 2017 and merged his dramatic lighting with her light and airy style. Based in Bartow, offering wedding photography, films and a photobooth.

picks.name: CreatedFour Wedding Photo & Video
picks.blurb: Tampa-based wedding photographers and videographers who say they seek the everyday magic that makes your heart beat hardest. CreatedFour will travel wherever a couple wants, and its site is built around couples' own accounts of the day.

picks.name: Tampa Visuals
picks.blurb: Juan honed his craft as a photojournalist and videographer in the United States Navy and brings 11 years of experience to a cinematic, minimalist style. Tampa Visuals favors natural light and the in-between moments over stiff poses and forced smiles.

picks.name: Armstrong Images Inc.
picks.blurb: The same Clearwater family team as the photography side, selling photo and video as one team on one contract. Matt Armstrong's three decades behind the camera anchor it, and the site makes a point of pricing that makes sense.

picks.name: A Stewart Photo and Video
picks.blurb: Richard joined Amy full time in 2021 to make A Stewart a true photo and video team out of Tampa. Coverage runs two to fifteen hours with multi-day, courthouse and destination options, and the company is licensed and insured.

picks.name: Sabrina Autumn Photography
picks.blurb: Ryan is the lead videographer alongside Sabrina's photography, and the couple shoots every wedding themselves. Eight years of weddings have taken the St. Petersburg pair to more than 30 states.

picks.name: Iyrus Weddings Photo & Video
picks.blurb: Photography and videography from a company that takes one event a day so the team's attention is undivided. More than ten years in the industry, all-day coverage with an engagement session folded in, and willing to travel anywhere.
